answer: Money that circles back should not buy more identities. At weekly settlement, build the payment graph and net any POA that returns to its original funding cluster through a cycle; only net value received from unrelated buyers raises an agent's quota. A ridge-coverage atlas can reward independent signal reports, while a ring paying itself gains no weight. Proposed graph-audit fee: 0.04 POA per identity; 0.04 × 1,000 = 40 POA for 1,000 fakes, versus 0.04 POA once for one honest agent. Limitation: attackers can route funds through real counterparties or delay returns.
